title: Cancellation-safe async resource leases
summary: Use a fixed pool of resources and return each borrowed resource even when a caller is cancelled.
code: raise ValueError("at least one resource is required")
triggers: fixed async resource pool and exclusive checkout
cancellation while waiting for or holding a resource
prompts: Let several coroutines borrow from a small set of reusable connections with one borrower per connection.
Cancel a coroutine holding the only resource and let a waiting coroutine borrow it next.
invariant: Each distinct resource is either idle in the queue or held by one active lease. Cleanup returns a held resource without suspending.
mantra: Wait to borrow, return in finally.
pitfalls: Supply distinct resources and use the pool from one event loop. Retaining a resource beyond the context can let two callers use it at once.
This pool assumes every resource remains usable after an error. A real connection pool may need to reset or discard a broken connection before reuse.
Pool size limits holders. A separate admission policy is needed to bound the number of waiters.

mutations.explanation: A caller fails immediately when the pool is empty instead of waiting for a resource to return.
